nowPlaying.overview: 7-year-old Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

nowPlaying.title: The Mongoose
nowPlaying.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

nowPlaying.title: Ghost Soldier
nowPlaying.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

nowPlaying.title: La Bola Negra
nowPlaying.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

nowPlaying.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
nowPlaying.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

nowPlaying.title: Ebenezer
nowPlaying.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

nowPlaying.title: The Beast
nowPlaying.overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

nowPlaying.title: Wildwood
nowPlaying.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

nowPlaying.title: Street Fighter
nowPlaying.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

nowPlaying.title: Obsession
nowPlaying.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

nowPlaying.title: Clayface
nowPlaying.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

nowPlaying.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

nowPlaying.title: How to Rob a Bank
nowPlaying.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

nowPlaying.title: Jailer 2
nowPlaying.overview: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

nowPlaying.title: The Cat in the Hat
nowPlaying.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

nowPlaying.title: Angel and the Badman
nowPlaying.overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

nowPlaying.title: Sense and Sensibility
nowPlaying.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

nowPlaying.title: Drummer Boy
nowPlaying.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

nowPlaying.title: Crawlers
nowPlaying.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

nowPlaying.title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
nowPlaying.overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

nowPlaying.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
nowPlaying.originalTitle: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
nowPlaying.overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

nowPlaying.title: Dune: Part Two
nowPlaying.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

nowPlaying.title: Wicker
nowPlaying.overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

nowPlaying.title: The Florist
nowPlaying.overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

nowPlaying.title: Whalefall
nowPlaying.overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

nowPlaying.title: Dune
nowPlaying.overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

nowPlaying.title: Animals
nowPlaying.overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

nowPlaying.title: Ranabaali
nowPlaying.overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

nowPlaying.title: Fresh Meat
nowPlaying.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

nowPlaying.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
nowPlaying.overview: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

nowPlaying.title: Rocky
nowPlaying.overview: Rocky Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, Rocky knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!

nowPlaying.title: Possible Love
nowPlaying.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

nowPlaying.title: Scene
nowPlaying.overview: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to come back from retirement when a new case resembles one he closed years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

nowPlaying.title: Fjord
nowPlaying.overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

nowPlaying.title: Being Heumann
nowPlaying.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

nowPlaying.title: Jimmy
nowPlaying.overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

nowPlaying.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
nowPlaying.originalTitle: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
nowPlaying.overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

nowPlaying.title: I Play Rocky
nowPlaying.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

nowPlaying.title: Training Day
nowPlaying.overview: On his first day on the job as a narcotics officer, a rookie cop works with a rogue detective who isn't what he appears.

nowPlaying.title: Klara and the Sun
nowPlaying.overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

nowPlaying.title: Love of Your Life
nowPlaying.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

nowPlaying.title: Victorian Psycho

nowPlaying.title: The Crow

nowPlaying.title: North by Northwest

nowPlaying.title: A Talent for Murder

nowPlaying.title: Pet Sematary
nowPlaying.overview: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.

nowPlaying.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
nowPlaying.overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

nowPlaying.title: The Angry Birds Movie

In this paradise, Red, a bird with a temper problem, speedy Chuck, and the volatile Bomb have always been outsiders. But when the island is visited by mysterious green piggies, it’s up to these unlikely outcasts to figure out what the pigs are up to.

nowPlaying.title: Fatherland
nowPlaying.overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

nowPlaying.title: A Very Arctic Christmas
nowPlaying.overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

nowPlaying.title: Christmas at the Kringles
nowPlaying.overview: After moving to a quiet suburban neighborhood, the Seversons meet the Kringles, a family that celebrates Christmas year-round. When Mark, the father, discovers the Kringles' sinister yuletide intentions, he teams up with a badass Santa in a high-stakes, action-packed fight to save his family.

nowPlaying.title: Monster Mia
nowPlaying.overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

nowPlaying.title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
nowPlaying.overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

nowPlaying.title: Treasure Trekkers
nowPlaying.overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

nowPlaying.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor

Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

nowPlaying.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

upcoming.originalTitle: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
upcoming.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

upcoming.title: Hexed
upcoming.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

upcoming.title: Focker-in-Law
upcoming.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, stepdad Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

upcoming.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
upcoming.originalTitle: La Bataille de Gaulle : J'écris ton nom
upcoming.overview: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

upcoming.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
upcoming.originalTitle: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
upcoming.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

upcoming.title: Violent Night 2
upcoming.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

upcoming.title: All of a Sudden
upcoming.overview: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

upcoming.title: Ray Gunn
upcoming.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

upcoming.title: Minotaur
upcoming.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

upcoming.title: Steps
upcoming.overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

upcoming.title: Behemoth!
upcoming.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

upcoming.title: Elsinore
upcoming.overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

upcoming.title: O.M: Operation Mole
upcoming.overview: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

upcoming.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
upcoming.overview: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

upcoming.title: Josephine
upcoming.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

upcoming.title: Flavia
upcoming.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

upcoming.title: Lilo & Scratch
upcoming.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

upcoming.title: Hershey
upcoming.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

upcoming.title: The Fox
upcoming.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

upcoming.title: November 1963
upcoming.overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

upcoming.title: The Vile
upcoming.overview: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.

upcoming.title: Above the Below
upcoming.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

upcoming.title: Tangles
upcoming.overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

upcoming.title: In Waves
upcoming.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

upcoming.title: Tender Loving Care
upcoming.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

upcoming.title: ENE Repeat
upcoming.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

upcoming.title: Eternal Return
upcoming.overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming

upcoming.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
upcoming.originalTitle: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
upcoming.overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.

upcoming.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
upcoming.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

upcoming.title: Ben'Imana
upcoming.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

upcoming.title: The Friend's House is Here
upcoming.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

upcoming.title: Dark Noon
upcoming.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

upcoming.title: A Long Winter
upcoming.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

upcoming.title: Mysaa
upcoming.overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

upcoming.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
upcoming.originalTitle: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
upcoming.overview: Andrew Lloyd Webber's, 'Starlight Express' races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.

upcoming.title: Ash and Crayons
upcoming.overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

upcoming.title: Alias Rukmini
upcoming.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

upcoming.title: 14th
upcoming.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

upcoming.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
upcoming.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

upcoming.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
upcoming.originalTitle: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
upcoming.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

upcoming.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
upcoming.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

upcoming.title: The Test
upcoming.overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

upcoming.title: Who Is Still Alive
upcoming.overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

upcoming.title: UK Holiday
upcoming.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

upcoming.title: GAME
upcoming.overview: Late summer 1993. After stealing a stash of money and drugs, aging raver David crashes his car deep in the woods - trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher discovers him, no rescue comes, only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills, and wits, unfolds - where survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.​

upcoming.title: Transplant
upcoming.overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

upcoming.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
upcoming.overview: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.

upcoming.title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
upcoming.originalTitle: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
upcoming.overview: An Ojibwe woman is awakened to her past and its bloody aftermath.

upcoming.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii..
upcoming.overview: Weary of years of neglect, a band of four complete misfits unwillingly teams up to save their village and loved ones. What ensues is absolute madness, chaos, and a riot of laughter as they defy the odds while discovering compassion, forgiveness, and friendship along the way.

upcoming.title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
upcoming.overview: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss.  An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew.. ‘Daughters of the Late Colonel’ is a merry, rude, and lyrical, animated adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

upcoming.title: Errand Guy
upcoming.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.

upcoming.title: Games We Play
upcoming.overview: Imogen accompanies her boyfriend Jack and his two childhood best friends on a weekend getaway. There, she must participate in a tournament of high-stakes games, leading her to question her sanity and her safety.

upcoming.title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
upcoming.originalTitle: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
upcoming.overview: Marian Turski, the world-renowned historian, journalist, and until his recent passing, president of the International Auschwitz Committee, takes us back to the roots of evil. A survivor of the Lodz Ghetto, Auschwitz, Buchenwald, and Theresienstadt death camps in his youth, Turski explains with firsthand knowledge and surgical precision how otherwise well-educated and cultured people can, under certain circumstances, turn into criminals and mass murderers. He reminds us about the painful past, explains the present, and warns about the future. His dramatic plea, "do not be indifferent!" remains more relevant now than ever. Andrzej Wolf, the director and cinematographer of this film, pays a loving tribute to one of the last moral compasses of the Greatest Generation.

upcoming.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
upcoming.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

upcoming.title: Vive le Punk
upcoming.overview: 50 years after the British Punk explosion, this documentary follows four bands that are still active today (Sham 69, 999, Ruts DC and The Boys) and features interviews with Charlie Harper, Joe Corre, Dr. John Cooper Clarke, Gaye Advert and other Punk Rock luminaries in search for the meaning of Punk and the relevance of its message today.  With rare archival footage, explosive live performances, and an unflinching look at the punk ethos in today’s world, this film is not just a retrospective—In a world that mirrors the one Punk once railed against, is the message still relevant—or has it been consumed by commercialism?. This film should appeal to every generation of rebels, misfits, and outsiders. Punk may have started as anarchy in the streets, but it’s far from finished. Vive le Punk!

upcoming.title: Precipice
upcoming.overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

upcoming.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
upcoming.originalTitle: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
upcoming.overview: The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen. Join the roar of the crowds in Kaohsiung in November and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour. Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

upcoming.title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
upcoming.originalTitle: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
upcoming.overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

upcoming.title: Sophomores
upcoming.overview: When a group of friends come back from college to have their annual Friendsgiving dinner, they realize that they have all changed since high school.

upcoming.title: A Dot in the Ocean
upcoming.overview: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

upcoming.title: What Happened On November 1st?
upcoming.overview: A whole college skips the second day of Halloweekend to celebrate Christmas on November 1st. Dressing festive, watching Christmas movies and playing music. However, there's a mystery...why and how are people getting murdered on November 1st?

upcoming.title: The Misty Man
upcoming.overview: A lonely film critic watches a romance in which the woman who rejected him falls for a movie star. Lost between the screen and his own imagination, he enters the film itself, hoping to rewrite a love story that was never meant to include him.

upcoming.title: The Jungle
upcoming.overview: Mariah is stuck in a self-destructive cycle of partying until she reconnects with an old friend who helps her rediscover her identity.

upcoming.title: The Holdout
upcoming.overview: Harold Milton, a fiercely independent rancher, is enraged when expanding AI data centers contaminate his land and water, killing his livestock and threatening his family’s livelihood. After confronting the development company CEO, Arthur Irwin, and discovering that they intend to proceed despite the harm, Harold finds himself increasingly isolated as neighboring ranchers accept lucrative buyouts. When Arthur and his security team are involved in a violent confrontation with Harold’s ranch hand, Harold decides that peaceful resistance is no longer enough. Armed with explosives and firearms, Harold is forced to take a stand before they take everything.

upcoming.title: My Girlfriend is a Serial Killer
upcoming.originalTitle: My Girlfriend is a Serial Killer
upcoming.overview: David comes home ready to propose to his longtime girlfriend. But when he walks on her in the middle of a gruesome murder, he's left questioning the relationship. Can he see past her murderous habits or will love prevail?

upcoming.title: Déjà Vu: The Eye of LuLu
upcoming.originalTitle: Déjà Vu: The Eye of LuLu
upcoming.overview: Mysterious assassinations and blackouts throughout Manhattan are linked to a major aerospace company, its corporate hit men, and two bumbling Russian agents hellbent on capturing the world-changing power of its AI technology. True-Crime Blogger Cassie Cole enlists the help of a masked whistle-blower, a high-end hacker, a CIA psychic, and the sassy sentient AI, to uncover their international conspiracy and its lethal consequences.
